title: ID0469627-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / RD 170003087] FW Update

additional_info.subject: Urgent Request for Remote FW Update - Charger SN 170003087
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team,
I hope this email finds you well.
We are seeking your professional support to assist us in performing a remote firmware update for the charger with Serial Number 170003087. We would like to have the unit upgraded to V.8.
We previously troubleshot this specific charger with Mr. Joao, and his recommendation was to proceed with this firmware update to resolve the issues encountered.
We strongly recommend that this update be completed as soon as possible. Kindly notify us the moment the process begins so that we can issue the necessary service announcements to our users.
Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.
Thanks and best regards,
Islam E. Dakroury
| Services Manager
Phone | (966) 553216466
